t.PARAFFINUM_LIQUIDUM.agn: It is not in the annexes of the EU Cosmetics Regulation; there is no specific limit or labelling rule.
t.PARAFFINUM_LIQUIDUM.eff.0: In the EU there is no health warning or usage limit specific to this substance. No substance-level scientific assessment has been read for this entry yet.
t.PARAFFINUM_LIQUIDUM.summary: A colourless, odourless oil refined from petroleum.
t.PARAFFINUM_LIQUIDUM.what: Forms an oily layer on the skin that reduces water loss and softens the skin.
